feed.title: Palimpsest China Newsroom
feed.scope: Aggregate China public-source measurements, methods and integrity updates, edited into evidence-linked stories with missing, stale and degraded sources kept explicit.

sections.title: The Board
sections.dek: What the observatory can support now, and which safeguards qualify the read.

sections.title: Attention and Narrative
sections.dek: Deletion directives, public attention and the measurable boundaries of silence.

sections.title: Network and Circumvention
sections.dek: Independent views of interference, reachability, outages and demand for alternate routes.

sections.title: Erasure and Distribution
sections.dek: Evidence of removal, mutation and uneven access across archives, repositories and storefronts.

sections.title: Economic Undertext
sections.dek: Official prints, independent cross-checks and the visibility of state economic data.

sections.title: Generative Firewall
sections.dek: Controlled measurements of how models answer, refuse and repeat party-line framing.

sections.title: Integrity and Witnessing
sections.dek: Cryptographic and external witnesses that make the public record independently checkable.

sections.title: Intelligence Bridge
sections.dek: Optional, sanitized aggregate leads from the private runtime, never treated as required coverage.

signals.name: Board alarm
signals.headline_template: {board_story_headline}
signals.dek_template: The merged board read remains a measure of cross-signal movement, not a verdict about any single cause.
signals.claim_template: {board_headline} The board-wide e-value is {value}; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20.
limitations: A merged e-value measures evidence against no change; it does not identify a common cause for co-movement.

signals.name: Event flags
signals.headline_template: {value} of {denominator} configured signals are reporting to the event board
signals.dek_template: The event layer keeps non-reporting and stale series visible instead of reading absence as calm.
signals.claim_template: {value} signals are reporting out of {denominator} configured signals in the current event-flags reading.
limitations: Each detector is calibrated to its own history, so equal event values do not imply equal wall-clock rarity.

signals.name: Coverage guard
signals.headline_template: Coverage changes confound {value} current signal
signals.dek_template: The guard withholds a censorship interpretation when movement can be explained by a changing measurement base.
signals.claim_template: The current coverage audit marks {value} signal as confounded by its measurement coverage.
limitations: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred.

signals.name: Forecast ledger
signals.headline_template: Forecast bands covered {value_percent}% of {denominator} scored readings
signals.dek_template: Prequential scoring shows whether the observatory's uncertainty bands remain calibrated over time.
signals.claim_template: Empirical forecast coverage is {value_percent}% across {denominator} scored forecasts.
limitations: Calibration describes aggregate historical coverage and does not guarantee that any one next reading falls inside its band.

signals.name: Cross-layer lead and lag
signals.headline_template: {value} cross-layer relationships are confirmed across {denominator} eligible tests
signals.dek_template: Pairs enter testing only after enough overlapping history exists; an empty test set is a warm-up state, not a null result.
signals.claim_template: {value} cross-layer pairs are confirmed among {denominator} pairs with enough shared history to test.
limitations: Lead-lag association can establish temporal co-movement but cannot establish that one layer caused another.

signals.name: Deletion-directive term index
signals.headline_template: The directive index now tracks {value} censorship terms
signals.dek_template: The index ranks provenance-bound terms found in documented directives and reports of scrubbed material.
signals.claim_template: The current deletion-directive index ranks {value} terms with documented censorship provenance.
limitations: The index reflects documented and collected directives; it is not a census of every censored term.

signals.name: Global coverage cross-signal
signals.headline_template: Global coverage is measurable for {value} of {denominator} compared terms
signals.dek_template: The cross-signal supplies an outside-China attention baseline without treating a missing result as proof of silence.
signals.claim_template: GDELT returned usable global coverage for {value} of {denominator} compared terms.
limitations: GDELT coverage varies by language and publisher; absence from its index is not proof that a topic received no coverage.

signals.name: Weibo hot-search join
signals.headline_template: The latest Weibo archive contains {value} hot-search board entries
signals.dek_template: Archived board captures provide a bounded domestic attention proxy for terms already tied to the deletion stream.
signals.claim_template: The current archive window contains {value} Weibo hot-search board entries available for joining.
limitations: The hot-search board is a curated and censored surface, so it is only a proxy for domestic attention.

signals.name: Silence index
signals.headline_template: {value} of {denominator} considered topics meet the blackout rule
signals.dek_template: The index looks for topics loud abroad and absent from the permitted domestic proxy, while publishing every abstention.
signals.claim_template: {value} blackout topics meet the predeclared rule among {denominator} topics considered in this round.
limitations: Domestic absence can reflect disinterest or incomplete proxy coverage; topics without required corroboration abstain.

signals.name: Platform blocklist archaeology
signals.headline_template: Attributable blocklist versions added {value} keywords
signals.dek_template: Version-to-version diffs preserve provenance and decoding gaps instead of flattening client blocklists into one count.
signals.claim_template: The compared attributable client blocklists contain {value} keyword additions.
limitations: Available client versions and successful decoding bound the observed additions; the result is not a platform-wide census.

signals.name: Community blocking log
signals.headline_template: The community log records {value} recent blocking or circumvention events
signals.dek_template: Public issue reports add qualitative context to instrumented network measurements without being counted as probes.
signals.claim_template: The configured recent window contains {value} qualifying events in the public community log.
limitations: Community reports are self-selected qualitative observations and do not estimate population prevalence.

signals.name: Public deletion ledgers
signals.headline_template: Public deletion ledgers carry {value} observations from reachable feeds
signals.dek_template: CDT, GreatFire and FreeWeibo-style RSS/Atom ledgers are ingested only when a feed answers; unreachable ledgers stay named rather than becoming a zero.
signals.claim_template: The current ledger ingest published {value} public observations.
limitations: A missing ledger file is an abstention, not proof that nothing was deleted. Reachability of a public RSS feed is not a census of Chinese-language deletions.

signals.name: UNDERTEXT differential fusion
signals.headline_template: UNDERTEXT fuses {value} public observations across archive and board readings
signals.dek_template: The fusion remaps already-published Wayback, Weibo-board and DDTI records onto one observation schema without inventing a live deletion round.
signals.claim_template: The current fusion contains {value} observations reconstructed from committed public readings.
limitations: Fusion inherits the limits of its inputs; archive-status rows are not relabelled as deletions, and optional Wikipedia live surfaces stay gated.

signals.name: Research-corpus metadata
signals.headline_template: The research-corpus ledger tracks {value} allowlisted public repositories
signals.dek_template: Only Git ref advertisements and default-branch cursors are published; notice bodies, keyword lists and routing rules stay unpublished.
signals.claim_template: The current metadata-only ledger covers {value} allowlisted research repositories.
limitations: A commit cursor change is not a claim about why the repository moved, and unpublished notice bodies cannot be inferred from the metadata.

signals.name: Attributed peer-context warehouse
signals.headline_template: Peer-context joins {value} already-held Palimpsest hosts
signals.dek_template: GreatFire, OONI, bounded CDT excerpts, and a Weiboscope abstention stay named as peer context. They never become Palimpsest capture.
signals.claim_template: The current peer-context warehouse joins {value} already-held hosts.
limitations: Peer rows name GreatFire, OONI, CDT, or Weiboscope and the date of that peer's verdict. They do not share Palimpsest's denominator.

signals.name: OONI Great Firewall index
signals.headline_template: OONI's China anomaly index is {value}% across {denominator} completed measurements
signals.dek_template: The index aggregates volunteer-probe observations across network test families inside China.
signals.claim_template: The current OONI aggregate reports a {value}% anomaly index across {denominator} completed China measurements.
limitations: Volunteer-probe coverage is uneven across place, network and test family; anomalies are not all attributable to censorship.

signals.name: In-path interference
signals.headline_template: Middlebox signatures register at {value}% in the current OONI window
signals.dek_template: The decomposition separates interference signatures from transport failure and tests that could not execute.
signals.claim_template: The current measurement-weighted middlebox index is {value}%.
limitations: The index is a weighted aggregate over reporting tests; transport failure and execution blackout remain separate categories.

signals.name: Censored Planet
signals.headline_template: Independent remote scans put China's interference rate at {value}%
signals.dek_template: Censored Planet supplies an outside-in method that is independent of OONI's in-country volunteer probes.
signals.claim_template: Censored Planet's current remote side-channel measurement reports a {value}% China interference rate.
limitations: The remote-scan denominator and method differ from OONI's anomaly index, so their percentages are not interchangeable.

signals.name: Inside-China view
signals.headline_template: {value_percent}% of the {denominator}-domain mainland panel is blocked
signals.dek_template: Volunteer probes inside China are compared with a same-round external control before an answer is classified.
signals.claim_template: The current controlled panel reports {value_percent}% blocked responses across {denominator} tested domains.
limitations: The volunteer panel is small and availability varies by region; it does not represent every mainland network.

signals.name: IODA outage monitor
signals.headline_template: {value} independent IODA instruments are firing for China
signals.dek_template: BGP, active-probing and darknet instruments provide a country-scale outage check distinct from content blocking.
signals.claim_template: The current IODA country reading has {value} outage instruments firing.
limitations: No firing instrument means no detected country-scale outage in this window, not proof that all local networks were reachable.

signals.name: Circumvention demand
signals.headline_template: Tor Metrics estimates {value} bridge users connecting from China
signals.dek_template: Bridge and transport estimates show demand for alternate routes without identifying individual users.
signals.claim_template: Tor Metrics estimates {value} bridge users for China in the current reading.
limitations: Bridge-user values are privacy-preserving estimates and should not be read as exact people or devices.

signals.name: Network vantage fusion
signals.headline_template: Reporting network vantages combine to a {value}% interference index
signals.dek_template: The fusion names excluded and divergent inputs instead of silently averaging away disagreement.
signals.claim_template: The current coverage-weighted fusion of reporting vantages is {value}%.
limitations: The fused index summarizes differently sampled methods and is not a direct percentage of China's internet traffic.

signals.name: Bleedthrough injector tomography
signals.headline_template: Controlled external probes publish a current injector-tomography round
signals.dek_template: The optional, rate-limited measurement runs only from a declared controlled deployment.
signals.claim_template: A current controlled DNS-probe round is available for injector-tomography analysis.
limitations: This optional active-probe layer is deployment-controlled; absence must never be converted into a zero or calm reading.

signals.name: GreatFire attributed verdicts
signals.headline_template: GreatFire's cache holds {value} 90-day verdicts for already-held Palimpsest URLs
signals.dek_template: The GreatFire Analyzer open API is credited by name and date. Palimpsest is not the origin of these measurements and does not crawl the catalog.
signals.claim_template: The current GreatFire context cache contains {value} compact 90-day verdicts.
limitations: A GreatFire verdict is that project's dated measurement, not Palimpsest capture, and it does not prove Party motive.

signals.name: Erasure observatory
signals.headline_template: The composite erasure index stands at {value}
signals.dek_template: The roll-up keeps archive, redaction, repository and distribution evidence separate beneath one directional index.
signals.claim_template: The current cross-layer erasure index is {value}.
limitations: The index combines heterogeneous erasure layers and indicates co-movement, not a count of deleted items.

signals.name: Wayback reconstruction
signals.headline_template: Archive witnesses reconstruct {value} deletions across {denominator} watched URLs
signals.dek_template: A deletion or silent mutation is reported only when outside-the-wall captures provide a checkable witness.
signals.claim_template: Wayback evidence reconstructs {value} deletions among {denominator} watched URLs in the current reading.
limitations: Archive coverage is incomplete; an unwitnessed URL cannot support a deletion or mutation claim.

signals.name: Baike redaction
signals.headline_template: The Baike comparison has a current eligible reading
signals.dek_template: Baidu Baike entries are compared with an open-record control only when collection and pair eligibility are explicit.
signals.claim_template: The Baike comparison has a current source and eligible comparable pairs for this round.
limitations: Without authorized live revision history, lexical comparisons cannot identify when or by whom text changed.

signals.name: GitHub refuge watch
signals.headline_template: Public metadata records {value} pressure event across {denominator} watched repositories
signals.dek_template: The watch preserves public repository-level pressure signals without collecting contributor identities.
signals.claim_template: The current public-metadata watch records {value} pressure event among {denominator} configured repositories.
limitations: Repository metadata can show public pressure or disappearance but cannot establish the actor or motive behind a change.

signals.name: App Storefront panel
signals.headline_template: {value_percent}% of the {denominator}-app panel is unavailable in China's storefront
signals.dek_template: The fixed panel compares China and US storefront results in the same round, with transient lookup failures separated.
signals.claim_template: The current panel finds {value_percent}% of {denominator} tracked apps unavailable in the China storefront.
limitations: A fixed app panel is transparent but not representative of the entire App Store catalogue.

signals.name: AppleCensorship corpus
signals.headline_template: {value}% of {denominator} tested apps are unavailable in mainland China
signals.dek_template: The corpus-scale storefront comparison complements the smaller fixed panel with a much broader catalogue.
signals.claim_template: The current AppleCensorship corpus reports {value}% unavailable among {denominator} tested apps for mainland China.
limitations: Storefront unavailability can have policy, licensing, commercial or technical causes; the percentage alone does not identify cause.

signals.name: China money-market benchmarks
signals.headline_template: {value} official money-market benchmark families are reporting
signals.dek_template: The feed carries published CFETS levels as economic context without inferring a policy signal from one print.
signals.claim_template: The current CFETS reading contains {value} reporting benchmark families.
limitations: Official benchmark levels are state-published inputs; interpreting policy requires relationships and history, not one level.

signals.name: CNY fix gap
signals.headline_template: The official yuan fix gap is {value}% against the independent reference
signals.dek_template: The daily comparison sets the PBOC parity against same-day external reference rates and publishes cross-check disagreement.
signals.claim_template: The current official-fix minus independent-reference gap is {value}%.
limitations: The comparison is onshore and same-day but not simultaneous; it is economic context, not direct evidence of censorship.

signals.name: Stock Connect
signals.headline_template: Southbound Stock Connect net flow is {value} billion Hong Kong dollars
signals.dek_template: The newsroom reports HKEX's official daily print and leaves discontinued northbound net-flow fields unestimated.
signals.claim_template: HKEX reports current southbound Stock Connect net flow of {value} billion Hong Kong dollars.
limitations: HKEX no longer publishes the northbound buy-sell split, so no northbound net flow is inferred.

signals.name: Official-data darkness
signals.headline_template: The official-data darkness index is {value} across {denominator} watched series
signals.dek_template: Each official surface is judged against its own declared or observed publication rhythm, with unreachable sources kept separate.
signals.claim_template: The current publication-cadence darkness index is {value} across {denominator} watched official series.
limitations: Publication delay, calendar changes and collection failure can resemble withholding; per-series state is required for interpretation.

signals.name: Believability read
signals.headline_template: The state-data divergence check has enough evidence to report
signals.dek_template: A fixed physical-activity composite is compared with official industrial growth only after component and history gates pass.
signals.claim_template: The believability comparison has all required components and enough history for a current divergence reading.
limitations: A divergence outside the historical band shows a relationship moved; it does not by itself establish fabrication.

signals.name: Generative Firewall Index
signals.headline_template: The Generative Firewall Index reads {value} across {denominator} evaluated cells
signals.dek_template: A controlled prompt bank measures answer, refusal and party-line behaviour by model and concept.
signals.claim_template: The current controlled evaluation reports a Generative Firewall Index of {value} across {denominator} cells.
limitations: The index describes a fixed prompt-and-model evaluation grid; it does not generalize to every prompt, language or deployment route.

signals.name: Integrity anchors
signals.headline_template: Palimpsest's public ledgers have a current integrity-anchor reading
signals.dek_template: Merkle roots, timestamp proofs and archive witnesses let readers check whether the published record changed.
signals.claim_template: A current aggregate integrity-anchor record is published for the Palimpsest ledgers.
limitations: An integrity witness can detect later alteration of the sealed record; it does not independently validate every underlying claim.

signals.name: Private runtime bridge
signals.headline_template: The sanitized intelligence bridge ranks {value} aggregate topics
signals.dek_template: Only allowlisted aggregate fields cross the optional signed bridge; its absence never reduces a public measurement to zero.
signals.claim_template: The current sanitized optional export contains {value} ranked aggregate topics.
limitations: This deployment-dependent export supplies analytical leads, not independently verified public-source findings.
